value: Card numbers as the game shows them (damage + Strength x hits, x0.75 under Weak; block + Dexterity, x0.75 under Frail) written into the existing columns lift the unchanged 10-29 net's pricing of attack cards when the player's Strength or Weak is up, with no games: correlation with the played-out change 0.156 to 0.218 (+0.060 (0.025), 1,324 pairs, bootstrap over positions), other pairs +0.009 (0.012); those pairs carry 31% of the net's squared error and priced perfectly would lift the overall correlation 0.18 to 0.53. Fine-tuning on paired labels showed no clear difference between the encodings (held-out noise about 0.05). No play read.
